add_library(dodev_gdb_core STATIC src/GdbConfig.cpp src/GdbBreakpoints.cpp "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/settings/Json.cpp" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/terminal/TerminalTasks.cpp")
set_target_properties(dodev_gdb_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(dodev_gdb_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_compile_features(dodev_gdb_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
add_library(dodev_gdb_plugin MODULE src/GdbPlugin.cpp)
target_link_libraries(dodev_gdb_plugin PRIVATE dodev_gdb_core)
set(GDB_BUILD_DIR "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/gdb-debugger")
set(GDB_INSTALL_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/gdb-debugger")
set_target_properties(dodev_gdb_plugin PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME dodev_gdb_plugin LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${GDB_BUILD_DIR}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${GDB_BUILD_DIR}")
if(WIN32)
  set_target_properties(dodev_gdb_plugin PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
elseif(APPLE)
  set_target_properties(dodev_gdb_plugin PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".dylib")
endif()
foreach(cfg DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
  set_target_properties(dodev_gdb_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${GDB_BUILD_DIR}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${GDB_BUILD_DIR}")
endforeach()
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${GDB_BUILD_DIR}")
configure_file(plugin.json "${GDB_BUILD_DIR}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
install(TARGETS dodev_gdb_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${GDB_INSTALL_DIR}" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${GDB_INSTALL_DIR}")
install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${GDB_INSTALL_DIR}")
